cells.gaps: No delivery plan is stated for this instrument in the rows (its Plano Operacional is approved with it but no row gives actions or cost), and no published report against its targets has been found; one older INTIC report (MOZ-031) gives its period as 2019-2023 against 2019-2028 in the resolution. The National Digital Transformation Strategy is still in drafting (launched 12 Feb 2026, its operational plan not costed, work deprioritised by the World Bank in 2025-26) and would replace it.
cells.note: Plano Estratégico para a Sociedade de Informação 2019-2028 (Resolution 52/2019): approved, text gazetted, period runs to 2028, so stage 3. Stage 4 needs a delivery plan and published results, and none is held.
